about.intro: CISAnalogy is built for CISA candidates who understand concepts better through story than through definition. Each chapter opens with a scenario — a bank vault, a border checkpoint, a badge system — and uses it to unpack a technical concept from the exam blueprint, so the idea has something to hang onto when you need to recall it under pressure.
about.body: It's written for people studying for the CISA exam who find dense manuals hard to retain, and who want a second, more memorable pass through the material — not a replacement for the official review manual, but a companion to it.

tagline: Every concept begins with a story.

hero.subtitle: CISAnalogy turns dense CISA concepts into stories and analogies you'll actually remember on exam day. Domain 1 is out now — four more domains are on the way.
